library(shiny)
library(sfsmisc)
t0 <- proc.time()[[3]]
library(qgam)
t1 <- proc.time()[[3]]

ns <- sort(setdiff(loadedNamespaces(), c("base", "stats", "graphics", "grDevices", "utils", "methods", "datasets", "tools", "parallel", "grid", "compiler", "splines")))
v  <- vapply(ns, function(k) as.character(packageVersion(k)), "")

tic <- function() proc.time()[[3]]
qu  <- c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)

srr <- function(S, y) runif(length(y), rowMeans(S < y), rowMeans(S <= y))

bo <- function(S, y) {
  B <- ncol(S)
  o <- function(C, s) mean(rowSums(C < s) == ncol(C) | rowSums(C > s) == ncol(C))
  b <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(i) o(S[, sample(seq_len(B)[-i], B, TRUE)], S[, i]), 0)
  mean(b >= o(S, y))
}

ui <- fluidPage(
  h4("qgam on shinylive: load and timing test"),
  verbatimTextOutput("ok"),
  fluidRow(
    column(3, numericInput("n", "Observations", 100, 10, 1000)),
    column(3, numericInput("B", "Simulations", 250, 50, 1000)),
    column(3, radioButtons("meth", NULL, c("qgam (3 fits)" = "qgam", "mqgam" = "mqgam"))),
    column(3, actionButton("go", "Run"))
  ),
  verbatimTextOutput("tm"),
  plotOutput("p", height = "450px")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$ok <- renderText(paste0(
    "ok\n",
    sprintf("library(qgam) incl. imports: %.2f s\n", t1 - t0),
    sprintf("%d namespaces loaded:\n", length(v)),
    paste(sprintf("  %-12s %s", ns, v), collapse = "\n")))
  
  res <- eventReactive(input$go, {
    n <- input$n
    B <- input$B
    x <- runif(n, -1, 1)
    y <- rpois(n, exp(1 + x))
    m <- glm(y ~ x, poisson)
    a <- tic()
    S <- matrix(unlist(simulate(m, B), use.names = FALSE), n)
    u <- srr(S, y)
    t1 <- tic() - a
    a <- tic()
    pb <- bo(S, y)
    t2 <- tic() - a
    q <- rank(fitted(m))
    d <- data.frame(u, q = q / max(q))
    k <- min(length(unique(d$q)), 10)
    g <- data.frame(q = seq(0, 1, length.out = 200))
    a <- tic()
    invisible(capture.output(
      if (input$meth == "qgam") {
        f  <- lapply(qu, function(p) qgam(u ~ s(q, k = k), d, qu = p))
        sm <- lapply(f, summary)
        P  <- sapply(f, predict, newdata = g)
      } else {
        f  <- mqgam(u ~ s(q, k = k), d, qu = qu)
        sm <- lapply(qu, function(p) qdo(f, p, summary))
        P  <- sapply(qu, function(p) qdo(f, p, predict, newdata = g))
      }))
    t3 <- tic() - a
    list(d = d, g = g, P = P, pb = pb, t = c(t1, t2, t3), meth = input$meth)
  })
  
  output$tm <- renderText({
    e <- res()
    sprintf("simulate + residuals: %.2f s\nbootstrap outlier test (p = %.3f): %.2f s\n%s, 3 quantiles (fit + summary + predict): %.2f s",
            e$t[1], e$pb, e$t[2], e$meth, e$t[3])
  })
  
  output$p <- renderPlot({
    e <- res()
    par(mar = c(4, 4, 1, 1))
    plot(e$d$q, e$d$u, xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), axes = FALSE,
         xlab = "Model predictions (rank transformed)", ylab = "DHARMa residual")
    eaxis(1)
    eaxis(2)
    matlines(e$g$q, e$P, lty = 1, lwd = 2, col = "black")
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
